<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Stone Guardian](/Feats.aspx?ID=4379) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown](/Sources.aspx?ID=210) pg. 83

**Archetype** [Stonebound](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=210)

**Prerequisites**
[Stonebound Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4377)

</column>

---

You learn to call a powerful guardian of earth and stone to your side. You can cast [_summon elemental_](/Spells.aspx?ID=320) as an innate primal spell once per day, and can only summon elementals with the [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55) trait. This spell is automatically heightened to half your level rounded up.
